reason: An orchestration plugin that bridges WeChat messaging to isolated DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, with slash-command controls and an optional browser panel.

summaries.zh: 通过微信 iLink 将消息接入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体会话，并提供按联系人隔离的会话管理、斜杠命令和可选浏览器设置面板。
summaries.en: Bridges WeChat iLink messages to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions with per-peer session management, slash commands, and an optional browser settings panel.

capabilities: Connects WeChat iLink messages to harness agent sessions
Creates and isolates one agent session per messaging peer
Accepts slash commands to create, list, inspect, and switch sessions or models
Exposes an optional browser settings panel and HTTP bridge
Allows connected agents to use the harness model, tools, and workspace
